Free Business E-Waste Collection

A fully licensed, zero-landfill IT recycling and secure data destruction service. Free for businesses of any size. No contracts, no obligations.

✓ Environment Agency Licensed ✓ NIST 800-88 Data Destruction ✓ Insured by Hiscox

What's Included (Free)

  • On-site collection at your premises
  • Secure transport with GPS tracking
  • NIST 800-88 compliant data wiping
  • Physical destruction for failed media
  • Waste Transfer Note (legal compliance)
  • Certificate of Destruction per batch

What We Accept

  • Laptops, desktops, and servers
  • Monitors and display screens
  • Mobile phones and tablets
  • Network switches, routers, cables
  • Printers and peripherals
  • Any IT or electronic equipment

Why It's Free

We operate a "Refurbish First" model. Viable equipment is securely wiped and refurbished for resale or donation. This recovered value covers logistics and data destruction costs. You get a free, compliant service — we get stock. Simple.

Your Legal Obligation

Under the Environmental Protection Act 1990, businesses have a legal "Duty of Care" to ensure waste is handled by a licensed carrier. Non-compliance risks unlimited fines. Our Waste Transfer Notes satisfy this obligation completely.
